title: Zesty Earthy Mediterranean Oats Pilaf
description: A savory and earthy ovo-vegetarian pilaf featuring ground oats, yuzu cure, and Mediterranean flavors, perfect for a midnight craving.

ingredients.name: ground oats
ingredients.notes: rolled or steel-cut work as well

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the ground oats and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the yuzu juice, chopped olives, artichoke hearts, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the crumbly feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
